mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_requests ( employee_id, approver_id, start_date, end_date, reason ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{approverId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT request_id, employee_id, approver_id, start_date, end_date, reason, status, created_at, decided_at, rejection_comment FROM leave_requests WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT lr.request_id,
lr.employee_id, e.employee_name AS applicant_name, e.department AS applicant_department,
lr.approver_id, a.employee_name AS approver_name, a.department AS approver_department,
lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.created_at, lr.decided_at, lr.rejection_comment
FROM leave_requests lr
INNER JOIN employees e ON lr.employee_id = e.employee_id
INNER JOIN employees a ON lr.approver_id = a.employee_id
ORDER BY lr.created_at ASC, lr.request_id ASC
ORDER BY lr.created_at DESC, lr.request_id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT lr.request_id,
lr.employee_id, e.employee_name AS applicant_name, e.department AS applicant_department,
lr.approver_id, a.employee_name AS approver_name, a.department AS approver_department,
lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.created_at, lr.decided_at, lr.rejection_comment
FROM leave_requests lr
INNER JOIN employees e ON lr.employee_id = e.employee_id
INNER JOIN employees a ON lr.approver_id = a.employee_id
WHERE lr.request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE leave_requests SET status = 'CANCELED', decided_at = NULL, rejection_comment = NULL WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'PENDING'
